cohort: 462 women with term singleton deliveries at the Yaoundé Central Hospital
finding: Gestational weight gain (GWG) above the Institute of Medicine (IOM) recommendations was significantly associated with poor maternal outcome, defined as caesarean section, preeclampsia, or obstetrical haemorrhage.
mod_finding: GWG above the IOM recommendation was significantly associated with caesarean section.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome, but specific values not provided
